description: Prior Approval for change of use of the existing building's first floor office (Use Class E) to a self-contained one bedroom, two person flat (Use Class C3).
application_type_full: Prior Approval: Change of use from Commercial, Business and Service (Use Class E), or betting office or pay day loan shop to mixed use including up to two flats (Use Class C3)
decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall begin no later than three years from the date of this decision.  

Reason:  To accord with the provisions of Schedule 2, Part 3, Paragraph MA.2 (5) of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) (England) Order 2015 (as amended).

Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved drawings:  95-184/PA/100, 95-184/PA/101 Received: 28 July 2026,  95-184/PA/103 Received: 27 July 2026,  95-184/PA/102 Received: 03 July 2026.  

Reason:  To accord with the provisions of Schedule 2, Part 3, Paragraph W.12 (a) of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) (England) Order 2015 (as amended).

Condition : 3 - Prior to the occupation of the first floor flat hereby permitted, the Local Planning Authority shall be informed of the agreed address name/ number for the approved flat in order for arrangements to be put in place to ensure that, with the exception of a person eligible for a disabled person's badge issued pursuant to Section 21 of the Chronically Sick and Disabled Persons Act 1970 (or similar legislation), no resident of the development shall obtain a resident parking permit.  Any occupiers of the approved first floor flat shall surrender any such permit wrongly issued or held.  

Reason:  To accord with the provisions of Schedule 2, Part 3, Paragraph MA.2 (2(a)) of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) (England) Order 2015 (as amended).

Condition : 4 - Prior to the occupation of the first floor flat hereby permitted, two internal resident cycle parking spaces, designed in accordance with the London Cycle Design Guidelines, shall be installed and made available for use by the first floor flat's occupiers only within the building's ground floor internal waste and cycle storage room hereby permitted, laid out in accordance with the submitted Proposed Ground Floor Plan (Ref: 95-184/PA/103), and be permanently retained as such.  

Reason: In order to support sustainable transport objectives in accordance with Schedule 2, Part 3, Paragraph MA.2 (2(a)) of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) (England) Order 2015 (as amended).

Condition : 5 - Prior to the occupation of the first floor flat hereby permitted, residual waste, food waste and recyclable material bins/ containers suitable for a one bedroom, two person flat, as specified by the Council's Recycling and Refuse Guidance: Guide for Architects and Planners (2022), for use by the first floor flat's occupiers only within the building's ground floor internal waste and cycle storage room hereby permitted, laid out in accordance with the submitted Proposed Ground Floor Plan (Ref: 95-184/PA/103), and be permanently retained as such.  

Waste bins shall be permitted to be positioned on the public highway for collection during designated collection days only, as agreed with the Council's Waste and Recycling Service, and at no other time.  No waste or waste bins shall be stored on the public highway at any other time.  

Reason:  In order to ensure adequate storage provision and collection arrangements for waste and recyclable materials and prevent obstruction to the public highway in accordance with Schedule 2, Part 3, Paragraph MA.2 (2(a)) of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) (England) Order 2015 (as amended).
